reviews.summary: No current, directly BAT-relevant exploit, outage, supply-unlock, regulatory action, or official adverse announcement was identified. A Phemex BAT/USDT delisting occurred August 28, but it does not establish an active risk for the unspecified BAT-EUR venue.

facts.fact: BAT identity is clear: Basic Attention Token on Ethereum (also bridged to Solana); the official FAQ lists the Ethereum contract as 0x0D8775F648430679A709E98d2b0Cb6250d2887EF. ([basicattentiontoken.org](https://basicattentiontoken.org/faq/?utm_source=openai))

An official July 9, 2026 BAT Roadmap 4.0 announcement describes planned ecosystem expansion; the fresh official result did not report a security incident, migration, or adverse token-supply action. ([basicattentiontoken.org](https://basicattentiontoken.org/author/basic-attention-token/?utm_source=openai))

Phemex delisted its BAT/USDT spot pair on August 28, 2026, including deposit and withdrawal shutdowns. This was venue-specific and predates the October 9 snapshot. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100011?utm_source=openai))

Recent official Brave transparency data was available as of September 30, 2026, indicating ongoing Brave/BAT rewards operations rather than a disclosed service shutdown. ([brave.com](https://brave.com/transparency/?utm_source=openai))
